text:
ops-bot: ALERT: Dedicated pool eu-west-1-gpu-24 reporting sustained tail latency > 1200ms for 3m, capacity_util=98%, SLA breach potential :warning:
oncall_mike: seeing the page, jumping in. any recent deploys to that pool? :eyes:
sri: I rolled out batching heuristic tweak to reduce small-batch overhead ~10:30 UTC, targeted pool selector change: prefer `kernel=v2-autotune` for seq_len<=512. Could that be related?
lee: infra metrics show a spike in queue length and slot evictions around 10:33 UTC, matches the rollout window. Also a tenant had a quota bump earlier today (tenant: adex-prod) that pushed reservations.
jess: can we get a quick profile of running kernels on the affected nodes? need kernel/cpu/gpu utilization breakdown.
eng-runtime-bot: kernel_usage_snapshot: {fp16-gemm: 12%, v2-autotune: 67%, fp32fallback: 21%} on node gpu-24-7 at 10:36 UTC.
sri: hmm v2-autotune is dominating, but we expected it to be faster. Need KV cache stats too.
infra-bot: kv_cache_metrics: pool-wide hit_rate dropped from 78% -> 14% at 10:34 UTC; cache_evictions rose x4.
maria: so KV cache degraded at the same time — maybe caching affinity broke after placement changes? customers hitting cold prefixes.
oncall_mike: I am going to scale the pool up by 2 nodes and temporarily throttle the tenant with quota bump. Executing now.
lee: scaling request accepted - adding nodes gpu-24-12 and gpu-24-13, ETA ~90s. Also isolating adex-prod flows to another placement queue.
sri: I'd like to rollback the batching heuristic on the runtime to previous version while we investigate. The change changed kernel selection priority which may have increased memory pressure and evictions. Can we roll back canary?
jess: agreed, rollback in 2 minutes. Marking as mitigation action.
eng-runtime-bot: rollback triggered: batching-heuristic -> v1-stable at 10:38:15 UTC, canary instances 0 -> 100% revert.
ops-bot: NOTE: SLA alert suppressed for this incident window while mitigations apply.
lee: KV cache hit rate recovering: 14% -> 62% at 10:41 UTC since eviction rate decayed. Queue length dropping.
sri: I pulled a flamegraph from the node before/after rollback. Key observations:
```
Before rollback (10:35):
- v2-autotune kernel: heavy kernel-launch overhead for small sequences
- LRU churn high -> KV lookup latency +8ms
- memory fragmentation -> increased per-request allocation
After rollback (10:42):
- fp16-gemm kernels higher throughput for mixed sequences
- KV hit rate restored
- overall p95 latency down ~40%
```
maria: any noisy neighbor evidence? did someone run large batching jobs on shared pool?
lee: yes, logs show a background retrain batch job (team: vision-research) spiked GPU mem usage around 10:32 and triggered eager eviction policies. That plus the quota bump = saturation.
jess: action items so far: 1) rollback batching heuristic (done), 2) scale + isolate tenant (done), 3) throttle background retrain job and adjust eviction tuning. Assigning follow-ups.
oncall_mike: throttled vision-research job at 10:44 UTC. Observed latency p95 now 420ms, under SLA. Marking incident as mitigated.
sri: we'll open a perf-regression PR to add a canary gating test for KV cache sensitivity and kernel-selection mem overhead. Also adding a metric alert for kv_hit_rate < 50% sustained.
maria: product note: inform affected customers (adex-prod) about transient SLA blip and mitigation actions.
lee: infra follow-up: fix placement policy so quota bumps require pre-check for noisy neighbor risk, and add soft reservation buffer for dedicated pools.
jess: postmortem owner: jess (will draft) — include timeline, root cause: interaction between batching heuristic kernel prioritization + unexpected quota bump + background GPU-heavy job -> KV cache thrash and evictions leading to fallback kernels and latency spike.
oncall_mike: thanks team. I'll keep monitoring the pool for next 6 hours and escalate if anything reappears. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: INCIDENT 1791234567 status: MITIGATED -> POSTMORTEM SCHEDULED.
eng-runtime-bot: logs attached: `/var/logs/runtime/eu-west-1/gpu-24/1791234567-profile.log` (snippet above).
sri: I'll push a tuning PR: revert v2-autotune priority and add heuristic: prefer fp16-gemm for mixed seq workloads; also add KV-prefetch for hot prefixes.
lee: created infra ticket #INF-984: placement safety checks + reservation buffer.
jess: leaving notes for SRE runbook update: add immediate throttling command and check-list for kernel-selection rollouts.
maria: I'll coordinate customer comms with support.
ops-bot: thread closed for now; reopen if p95 > 800ms or kv_hit_rate < 50% for 10m.
